source.title: Senior Delegate Announcement - USA & Canada (November 2021)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Senior Delegate for USA & Canada - Matthew Dickman. We would like to thank Kit Clement for his service as Senior Delegate for the region previously.

Matthew was selected by the WCA Board by voting among them, following Section 4 of our [Motion](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2021.1%20-%20Senior%20Delegates.pdf) about Senior Delegates.

We wish Matthew the best of luck in fulfilling his new duties. His term as Senior Delegate began on November 18, 2021.

An application was also received from James Hildreth for the position. We want to thank both applicants for their willingness in helping the WCA and the Speedcubing Community even more than they currently do. You can view both of their candidacy documents [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1LepBUuo0rw2ol6k-AS3tKYj1boY604VJ?usp=sharing).

translation.title: 美国及加拿大高级代表任命公告（2021 年 11 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，Matthew Dickman 将担任美国及加拿大地区的新任高级代表。感谢 Kit Clement 此前担任该地区高级代表期间的付出。

WCA 董事会依照高级代表[动议](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2021.1%20-%20Senior%20Delegates.pdf)第 4 节的规定，通过内部投票选定了 Matthew。

祝 Matthew 顺利履行新的职责。他的高级代表任期自 2021 年 11 月 18 日开始。

James Hildreth 也申请了这一职位。感谢两位申请者愿意在现有工作之外，进一步帮助 WCA 和速拧社区。两人的申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1LepBUuo0rw2ol6k-AS3tKYj1boY604VJ?usp=sharing)查看。
